text:
kayla: quick note — saw weird ordering and duplicated page processing from our Go sampleapp when using prefetch/concurrency. Observed duplicate work + 429s. Repro steps: start sample-go with --prefetch=4 --concurrency=3 and run flood test. Some prefetched pages are processed out-of-order and server returns same cursor again.

mohit: logs?

kayla: logs show cursor claim + ack mismatch:
[fetch] cursor=tok-77 claim=1
[proc] start cursor=tok-77
[auth] 200
[proc] finished cursor=tok-77
[ack] failed-> retry cursor=tok-77
[fetch] cursor=tok-77 -> duplicate deliver
[api] 429 burst

ci-bot: load-test-bot: 429 burst detected (window=1m, count=140) :exclamation:

pat: sounds like server-side lease expiration + client ack ordering issue. If ack RPC fails we requeue on server and client prefetch may already have triggered a second fetch. Are you seeing any network flaps causing ack RPC to fail?

kayla: no network flaps. ack RPC returned 504 occasionally during heavy load. The client retries immediately which picks up stale cursor. Also Go sdk's paginator uses a buffered channel for prefetch and doesn't cancel in-flight fetches when a cursor is acked elsewhere.

elaine: possible fixes: 1) client: maintain inflight-cursor map and dedupe fetches by cursor id; cancel in-flight fetch on successful ack from another worker; 2) server: implement short claim-window and explicit cursor-claim handshake so duplicate delivers are suppressed while claim is active; 3) sdk: add an optional 'ackStrategy: strict' that waits for ack confirmation before allowing prefetch to proceed for that cursor.

sam: small mitigation: set --prefetch=1 or --concurrency=1 on onboarding. Add sampleapp flag --ack-retries=backoff to avoid immediate requeue. Also add a client-side jitter before retrying an ack RPC to reduce thundering.

mohit: can we add an integration test to go-sdk that simulates ack RPC 504 then ensures paginator emits each cursor exactly once under prefetch=3? also check parity with js and py sdk behavior.

kayla: will open PR with inflight dedupe + test. adding config: Paginator{Prefetch:3, Concurrency:3, DedupeWindowMs:200} default 0. Will document in onboarding: 'If you observe duplicated pages during first-run, reduce prefetch or upgrade to go-sdk >= v0.9.5'.

pat: note for server team — consider server-side claim window and per-cursor idempotency to avoid double work. filing ticket.

ci-bot: ticket created: SRV-5421 (cursor-claim) by pat

kayla: thanks all. I'll include a small sample in the release notes and a short troubleshooting FAQ for onboarding.
